foxdusk.name: Foxdusk
foxdusk.title: Plan it with Hookdusk. Edit it with Foxdusk.
foxdusk.description: We built two tools from our own production work, and both run on your own computer. Hookdusk plans your TikTok, Reels and Shorts: topics for your niche, hooks that stop the scroll and a script ready to film, in BM or English. Foxdusk AIOS turns the raw talking-head recording into a finished video with clean cuts, branded captions and motion graphics.
features: Hookdusk: topics, hooks and scripts in BM or English
Foxdusk: dead air and retakes cut for you
Foxdusk: branded captions and motion graphics
Both apps in English and Bahasa Melayu
